job.title: Temporary Accounts Receivable Officer
job.description:
Job Summary

We are recruiting on behalf of an established organisation in the Cayman Islands for an experienced Temporary Accounts Receivable Officer to provide support within its busy Finance team. You will take responsibility for day-to-day accounts receivable activities, including invoicing, payment processing, collections, reconciliations and financial reporting, while providing a professional service to internal and external stakeholders.
 

Company Information

You will be joining a well-established organisation within the education sector, working as part of a collaborative Finance team. The environment is professional, community-focused and values integrity, teamwork and high standards, making this a great opportunity if you enjoy a hands-on accounting role with regular interaction across the wider organisation.
 

Responsibilities and Duties

In this Temporary Accounts Receivable Officer role, you will:

  • Manage day-to-day accounts receivable, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and in line with established accounting procedures.
  • Prepare invoices and statements, process incoming payments and accurately post transactions within QuickBooks.
  • Reconcile the accounts receivable ledger, bank transactions and other financial records, investigating discrepancies where required.
  • Monitor outstanding balances and follow up on overdue accounts, including preparing delinquency and aged receivables reports.
  • Respond professionally to billing, payment and account queries from customers and other stakeholders.
  • Prepare regular Excel reports, financial statements and accounts receivable updates for management.
  • Assist with general accounting activities, including petty cash, banking, fixed assets, budgeting and financial reporting.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and support internal and external audit and compliance requirements.
 

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A Degree, Diploma or recognised qualification in Finance or Accounting.
  • At least three years’ experience in a similar accounts receivable or accounting position.
  • At least three years’ practical experience using QuickBooks.
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel skills and strong general Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • A sound understanding of general accounting principles and practices.
  • Excellent accuracy, attention to detail and accountability when working with financial information.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and time management skills, with the discretion to handle sensitive and confidential information.
 

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive hourly rate.
  • Temping provides the opportunity to explore various industries and companies, allowing you to gain diverse experience and build professional connections while enjoying the flexibility of short-term roles.
  • Standard benefits as per Labour Law - (vacation, pension, and health insurance)

job.title: Temporary Accounts Assistant
job.description:
Job Summary

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established organisation in the Cayman Islands for a Temporary Accounts Assistant to provide immediate support to its finance function. This is an initial three-month temporary contract, with the possibility of a one-month extension, and would suit an experienced accounting professional who is available to start as soon as possible and can quickly get up to speed. 


Company Information

You will be joining an established organisation within the insurance sector, working alongside its accounting and finance team. The environment is busy and hands-on, making this a great opportunity if you are self-motivated, dependable and comfortable working independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.


Responsibilities and Duties

In this Temporary Accounts Assistant role, you will:

  • Work directly with accounting systems, including QuickBooks.
  • Complete reconciliations across multiple bank accounts.
  • Support day-to-day Accounts Payable activities.
  • Post daily premium receipts from bank statements into the general ledger.
  • Prepare and complete other account reconciliations as required.
  • Assist with insurance premium invoicing and other invoicing activities.
  • Provide wider accounting support to the finance team as required.


Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A minimum of three years’ accounting experience, ideally within a similar hands-on accounts role.
  • Strong practical accounting knowledge, although a professional accounting qualification is not required.
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel skills and confidence using Microsoft Word.
  • The ability to work under pressure, multitask and maintain a high level of accuracy.
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to learn quickly.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
  • A reliable approach with proven ability to manage deadlines effectively.


Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive hourly rate.
  • Temping provides the opportunity to explore various industries and companies, allowing you to gain diverse experience and build professional connections while enjoying the flexibility of short-term roles.
  • Standard benefits as per Labour Law - (vacation, pension, and health insurance)

job.title: Sales Supervisor and Customer Support
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for an experienced Sales Manager/Customer support to deliver a highly personalised service to private aviation clients, including ultra-high-net-worth passengers, aircraft owners, operators and flight crews. You will oversee the complete guest experience, build lasting client relationships and promote the company’s services, while ensuring each arrival and departure is handled professionally, discreetly and efficiently.

Company Information

Our client provides premium services within the private aviation industry. The company is known for professionalism, discretion and a strong commitment to personalised customer care. You will join a close-knit airport services team and work closely with pilots, aircraft operators, vendors and other stakeholders to create a seamless experience for a discerning international clientele. 

Responsibilities and Duties

In this role, you will:

  • Provide high-level, personalised support to private aviation passengers, aircraft owners, operators and flight crews.
  • Build trusted relationships with UHNW clients, understanding their individual preferences and anticipating their needs.
  • Manage client enquiries and service requests from initial contact through to arrival, departure and follow-up.
  • Promote FBO services, identify new business opportunities and help increase revenue through strong client relationships.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external providers to deliver smooth, timely and discreet service.
  • Respond professionally to changing requirements, special requests and service concerns.
  • Maintain accurate client and operational records while protecting confidentiality at all times.
  • Monitor service standards and identify opportunities to strengthen the overall client experience.

Qualifications and Skills

You should bring:

  • Experience in luxury hospitality, private aviation, VIP services, concierge services or another high-end customer-facing environment.
  • A proven ability to support UHNW individuals, senior executives or other discerning clientele.
  • Strong sales, business development and relationship-management skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills and a polished, professional manner.
  • A discreet and trustworthy approach when handling confidential information and sensitive requests.
  • The ability to remain calm, organised and responsive in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.
  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience, ideally within aviation or premium customer service.
  • Flexibility to work early mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays according to flight schedules and client needs.

Benefits and Perks

This position offers:

  • A client-facing leadership role within the private aviation industry.
  • The opportunity to work with an international UHNW clientele.
  • Direct involvement in sales, client retention and business development.
  • A varied position where you can shape and elevate the customer experience.
  • Exposure to private and charter aircraft operations.
  • The opportunity to lead a service-focused team and build valuable industry relationships.

job.title: Marketing Assistant
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a creative and organised Marketing Assistant to support marketing activity across a diverse portfolio of brands. You will help create engaging content, manage social media and website updates, support digital marketing campaigns and assist with the promotion and delivery of corporate and special events.

Company Information

Our client is an established group of companies operating across several consumer-facing brands and business sectors. You will join a collaborative and fast-paced marketing team where creativity, teamwork and attention to detail are highly valued. Working closely with the Marketing Manager and senior operational leadership, you will help deliver the group’s marketing goals while maintaining a consistent brand presence across its businesses. 

Responsibilities and Duties

As Marketing Assistant, you will:

  • Create promotional content and marketing collateral, including brochures, blogs, advertising copy and branded materials.
  • Assist with photography, video production and basic graphic design for campaigns and promotions.
  • Create, schedule and publish content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Monitor social media engagement, assist with customer interactions and identify opportunities to improve brand visibility.
  • Support digital marketing campaigns, product launches, promotions and seasonal initiatives.
  • Maintain and update website content, ensuring information and promotional materials remain accurate and current.
  • Assist with marketing analytics by compiling, analysing and reporting on relevant marketing trends.
  • Support corporate and special events through event promotion, branded materials, photography, social media coverage and on-site coordination. 

Qualifications and Skills

To succeed in this position, you should have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related subject, or at least three years of relevant marketing experience.
  • Knowledge of tools and platforms such as Canva, Adobe and Google Analytics.
  • Experience in social media management, content creation, website analytics and digital advertising.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • A creative approach with the ability to produce fresh, engaging marketing content.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and a professional approach to costs, deadlines and quality.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of digital marketing trends, social media best practices and online marketing.

Benefits and Perks

This opportunity offers:

  • A varied marketing role supporting multiple brands and business areas.
  • Hands-on experience across content creation, social media, digital marketing, website management and events.
  • The opportunity to develop your photography, video production and graphic design skills.
  • Exposure to marketing campaigns, product launches, promotions and seasonal initiatives.
  • A collaborative position within an established marketing team.
  • A full-time, Monday-to-Friday schedule, with additional evening or weekend hours required for certain events.
  • A mix of office-based work, event attendance and travel between group locations when applicable.

job.title: Event Manager
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for an experienced and creative Event Manager to lead the planning and delivery of high-quality events. You will manage the Events Team, oversee multiple projects from initial concept through to completion, maintain strong client relationships and ensure each event is delivered efficiently, within budget and in line with the client’s expectations.

Company Information

Our client is an established event rentals and services business based in the Cayman Islands. The company offers a fast-paced, creative and client-focused working environment where quality, teamwork and attention to detail are valued. You will join and supervise a dedicated team of Event Coordinators and event staff, working collaboratively with marketing and other internal departments to deliver successful events and support continued business growth. 
 

Responsibilities and Duties

As Event Manager, you will:

  • Lead, motivate and support the Events Team, overseeing schedules, staffing requirements and daily priorities. 
  • Manage multiple events from initial design and planning through to on-site delivery and post-event review. 
  • Interpret client briefs, present and sell creative ideas, and ensure events meet client expectations and agreed budgets. 
  • Oversee event contracts, budgeting, invoicing and sponsorship negotiations. 
  • Manage client relationships and identify opportunities to attract new business and improve service quality. 
  • Develop standard operating procedures and manage the team’s operational and administrative processes. 
  • Work with the Marketing Department on brand management and the promotion of events and new inventory. 
  • Conduct venue inspections and ensure compliance with all relevant insurance, legal, health and safety obligations.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this position, you should have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Event Management or a related field, or at least five years of event planning experience. 
  • Proven experience as an Event Manager, Event Planner or Event Organiser.
  • Strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate, organise and support an events team. 
  • Excellent communication, presentation and client relationship management skills.
  • Creativity, innovation and the confidence to develop and present event concepts.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events independently.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a professional approach to budgets, costs and deadlines. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and social media platforms. 

Benefits and Perks

This opportunity offers:

  • A senior, hands-on position with responsibility for leading an established events team.
  • The opportunity to manage varied events from creative concept through to final delivery.
  • Direct involvement in event design, brand management and business development.
  • A collaborative role working across events, operations and marketing.
  • The opportunity to develop processes and influence event quality and customer service.
  • A full-time, Monday-to-Friday schedule, with additional evening and weekend work required for certain events.
  • A varied working environment that includes office-based duties, venue inspections and on-site event management.

job.title: Personal Assistant
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a highly organised and discreet Personal Assistant based in the Cayman Islands. In this full-time role, you will provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a Director or Senior Executive, helping to manage schedules, communications, documentation and day-to-day business priorities. This position would suit someone proactive, dependable and comfortable handling confidential information in a busy professional environment. 

Company Information

Our client is a Cayman Islands-based organisation offering a professional and collaborative working environment. You will join the administrative and executive office team, working closely with senior leadership while coordinating with employees, clients, suppliers and other external stakeholders. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Manage calendars, appointments, meetings and executive schedules.
  • Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas and take accurate meeting notes when required.
  • Draft, format and proofread correspondence, reports, presentations and other business documents.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing emails, telephone calls and general correspondence.
  • Maintain organised electronic and physical filing systems, records and confidential information.
  • Coordinate business travel, accommodation, itineraries, appointments and events.
  • Liaise professionally with employees, clients, suppliers and external service providers.
  • Track outstanding actions, deadlines, renewals and important dates, ensuring appropriate follow-up. 

You may also provide limited personal administrative support, such as arranging appointments, reservations or deliveries, where reasonable and appropriate to the role. 

Qualifications and Skills

  • Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant or in a similar support role.
  • Excellent organisational, time-management and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with a professional telephone and email manner.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to prepare accurate documents and reports.
  • Ability to work independently, use initiative and remain calm under pressure.
  • High levels of discretion, confidentiality, reliability and professional judgement.
  • A valid Cayman Islands driving licence would be advantageous where driving is required.

Benefits and Perks

  • Full-time, office-based employment in the Cayman Islands.
  • A varied role supporting senior leadership and wider business activities.
  • Exposure to executive administration, business projects, meetings and external stakeholder coordination.
  • The opportunity to work independently and take ownership of schedules, deadlines and administrative priorities.
  • A professional environment where reliability, initiative and strong relationship-management skills are valued.

The role may occasionally require flexibility outside normal business hours to support meetings, events or urgent business matters.

job.title: Finance Analyst (12-month contract)
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client, a leading financial services organisation in the Cayman Islands, for an experienced Finance Analyst specialising in Financial and Management Reporting. You will support accurate month-end reporting, reconciliations, audit requirements, intercompany accounting and financial analysis across a varied portfolio of banking and wealth management entities. 

Company Information

Our client operates within the banking and financial services industry, providing international banking and wealth services, including mutual funds, trust, private banking and international advisory services. You will join a collaborative finance team that values customer service, regulatory compliance, strong business controls and an inclusive, high-performance culture. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Support the month-end close process, including preparing and posting journals to the general ledger.
  • Complete monthly general ledger reconciliations, certifications and attestations, including GAAP reconciliations.
  • Prepare intercompany balance schedules, payments, charge-outs and reporting against plan, investigating variances where required.
  • Maintain fixed asset and depreciation schedules and prepare the associated accounting entries.
  • Coordinate external audit requests, confirmations and supporting reports to help meet statutory deadlines.
  • Produce financial analysis, reports and insights to support management decision-making.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly tax account information and respond to related queries.
  • Assist with the implementation of new IFRS requirements, accounting policies, procedures and general ledger accounts.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Formal training in accounting, banking or finance, supported by relevant financial services experience.
  • Strong accounting knowledge, financial judgement and understanding of financial reporting processes.
  • Knowledge of banking operations, accounting procedures, financial reporting systems and relevant policies.
  • Advanced computer literacy with strong proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Excellent analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, combined with professional judgement and tact.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective relationships with senior management and internal and external stakeholders. 

Benefits and Perks

  • Exposure to a diverse portfolio of international banking and wealth management entities.
  • The opportunity to develop your experience across financial reporting, management reporting, audit and accounting policy.
  • A collaborative and inclusive working environment.
  • Regular interaction with senior officers and management personnel.
  • A varied role involving financial analysis, regulatory requirements and business decision support.
  • An office-based position within an established Cayman Islands financial services organisation.

job.title: Payroll Specalist
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a detail-focused Payroll Specialist to manage payroll data, calculate worldwide payroll tax withholdings and process monthly payments for employees across multiple locations. You will play an important role in maintaining accurate payroll records, completing bank reconciliations and protecting confidential employee information. 

Company Information

Our client operates in an international environment, processing payroll payments for employees around the world. You will work closely with the business owner or representative while supporting a payroll function built around accuracy, confidentiality, data integrity and reliable processes. This is an excellent opportunity to join a professional working environment where strong organisation and attention to detail are highly valued. 

Responsibilities and Duties

As Payroll Specialist, you will:

  • Calculate, enter and maintain employee and account information within the company’s payroll software.
  • Review payroll data for accuracy, correcting, deleting or re-entering information where required.
  • Create and maintain online banking templates for employees.
  • Calculate worldwide payroll tax withholdings and prepare payroll funding reports.
  • Process monthly international payroll payments through an online banking system.
  • Complete bank reconciliations and maintain the company’s escrow Excel spreadsheet.
  • Track employee leave accrual and keep payroll information up to date.
  • Follow payroll procedures, data integrity standards and security policies while identifying required process changes. 

Qualifications and Skills

To succeed in this payroll position, you should have:

  • Previous data entry experience, ideally within payroll or a related financial administration role.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office, with strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Enterprise; knowledge of the QuickBooks Payroll module would be an advantage.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Outlook, general administrative duties and standard office equipment.
  • Excellent typing speed and accuracy, with careful attention to numerical and employee data.
  • Strong organisational and communication skills.
  • A thorough, professional and dependable approach to your work.
  • A clear understanding of confidentiality when handling sensitive payroll and banking information. 

Benefits and Perks

The position offers:

  • Hands-on responsibility for an international payroll function.
  • Exposure to worldwide payroll processing and tax withholding calculations.
  • Regular use of QuickBooks Enterprise, Microsoft Excel and online banking platforms.
  • A varied role covering payroll administration, reporting, reconciliations and employee leave tracking.
  • The opportunity to take ownership of accurate and confidential payroll data.
  • A professional position where your organisation, reliability and attention to detail will have a direct impact.

job.title: Financial Advisor
job.description:
Job Summary

We are recruiting on behalf of a leading financial services organisation seeking an experienced Financial Advisor to join its growing team. In this client-facing role, you will manage and develop a portfolio of clients, provide tailored financial planning and wealth management advice, and identify new business opportunities while delivering exceptional service and helping clients achieve their long-term financial goals.

Company Information

This opportunity is with a well-established organisation operating within the financial services and wealth management sector. Known for its collaborative culture, commitment to innovation, and focus on delivering personalised financial solutions, the company supports both clients and employees in achieving long-term success.

You will join a professional team of financial services specialists dedicated to providing trusted financial advice, investment solutions, and wealth management services. The organisation values relationship-building, integrity, and operational excellence, creating an environment where your contributions can make a meaningful impact. 

Responsibilities and Duties

As a Financial Advisor, you will:

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of existing clients while delivering a high standard of service. 
  • Conduct regular client reviews to assess financial goals, investment objectives, and changing circumstances. 
  • Develop and present tailored financial plans, investment recommendations, and wealth management strategies. 
  • Build strong, long-term relationships through proactive communication and personalised advice. 
  • Generate new business opportunities through networking, referrals, prospecting, and relationship development. 
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients and contribute to revenue growth objectives. 
  • Monitor market developments, industry trends, and regulatory changes to ensure advice remains relevant and compliant. 
  • Maintain accurate client records and ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, policies, and ethical standards. 

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • Experience within financial services, wealth management, banking, insurance, investments, or a client advisory role. 
  • A strong understanding of financial planning principles, investment products, and suitability requirements. 
  • Demonstrated success in client relationship management and business development. 
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills. 
  • The ability to build trust and establish long-term client relationships.
  • Professional qualifications such as CISI, CFP, Series Licences, or similar industry certifications are highly desirable. 
  • Knowledge of the Cayman Islands financial services environment and regulatory framework would be advantageous. 

Benefits and Perks

In return, you can expect:

  • The opportunity to join a growing organisation during an exciting period of transformation. 
  • A collaborative and forward-thinking team environment.
  • Exposure to a diverse portfolio of clients and wealth management solutions.
  • Opportunities to develop your professional expertise and industry knowledge.
  • A culture that encourages innovation and recognises individual contributions.
  • The ability to make a meaningful impact on both client outcomes and business growth.
  • A professional environment built on integrity, collaboration, and operational excellence.

job.title: Trust Officer
job.description:
Job Summary

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Trust Officer to join a respected financial services organisation in the Cayman Islands. Recruiting on behalf of a leading fiduciary services provider, we are seeking a professional who can oversee and administer a portfolio of trusts, foundations, companies, and other wealth planning structures while delivering exceptional client service and maintaining the highest standards of regulatory compliance.

Company Information

This opportunity is with a well-established international financial services organisation that specialises in fiduciary, trust, and corporate administration services. The firm is known for its professional, collaborative, and client-focused culture, offering employees the opportunity to work alongside experienced fiduciary professionals in a highly regulated and fast-paced environment.

You will join a knowledgeable and supportive team dedicated to delivering high-quality trust and corporate services to an international client base while maintaining strong governance and compliance standards.

Responsibilities and Duties

As a Trust Officer, you will:

  • Manage the day-to-day administration of trusts, foundations, companies, and other fiduciary structures.
  • Coordinate the establishment of new trust mandates and the transition of existing appointments.
  • Maintain trust files, statutory records, banking arrangements, and custody records.
  • Process client transactions, including distributions, payments, and asset transfers.
  • Prepare trustee and corporate governance documentation, including minutes and resolutions.
  • Liaise with clients, legal advisers, banks, auditors, investment managers, and other professional service providers.
  • Ensure compliance with AML, CRS, FATCA, economic substance, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor statutory deadlines, support audits, and contribute to continuous process improvements.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Law, or a related discipline.
  • A minimum of five years' experience within the financial services industry.
  • Strong knowledge of trust administration, corporate administration, and fiduciary responsibilities.
  • An internationally recognised professional qualification such as STEP, ACCA, CPA, or CA would be advantageous.
  • Working knowledge of AML, CRS, FATCA, economic substance, and related regulatory frameworks.
  • Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional client-focused approach.
  • Sound analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

Benefits and Perks

In return, you can expect:

  • The opportunity to work with a respected international financial services organisation.
  • Exposure to a diverse portfolio of high-net-worth and corporate clients.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Ongoing professional development and learning opportunities.
  • Exposure to complex trust, fiduciary, and corporate structures.
  • The chance to contribute to process improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
  • A professional culture that values integrity, teamwork, and accountability.
  • A stable and rewarding career path within the fiduciary services sector.

job.title: Customer Service Agent
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established financial services organisation for a Customer Service Agent (Teller). In this role, you will be at the forefront of customer interaction, delivering a high-quality banking experience through accurate transaction processing and personalised service. You will also play an important part in identifying customer needs and supporting product uptake, contributing to both customer satisfaction and business growth.

Company Information

You will be joining a reputable and forward-thinking organisation within the banking and financial services sector. The company is known for its commitment to operational excellence, strong governance, and customer-centric approach.

The culture is collaborative, supportive, and performance-driven, encouraging professional development and innovation. You will work as part of a dynamic branch team, where attention to detail, teamwork, and excellent service standards are highly valued.

Responsibilities and Duties

As a Customer Service Agent (Teller), your responsibilities will include:

  • Providing a professional, courteous, and efficient service to customers at all times
  • Processing transactions accurately, including deposits, withdrawals, and drafts
  • Verifying customer information, signatures, and account balances before completing transactions
  • Maintaining cash levels within authorised limits and balancing daily cash positions
  • Ensuring all cash, instruments, and documents are securely handled and stored
  • Supporting ATM and night depository balancing and reconciliation processes
  • Promoting and cross-selling banking products and services to meet customer needs
  • Adhering to compliance, AML, and internal policies, ensuring all documentation is completed correctly

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

  • A high school diploma or equivalent qualification
  • 1–2 years’ experience in a customer service or cash-handling role (banking experience advantageous)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with customers
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial transactions
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • A proactive approach to identifying customer needs and sales opportunities
  • A high level of integrity and commitment to confidentiality and compliance standards

Benefits and Perks

The organisation offers a supportive environment and a range of benefits, including:

  • Opportunity to work with a reputable and growing financial services provider
  • A collaborative and team-oriented workplace culture
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to a variety of banking operations and customer interactions
  • Career progression opportunities within a structured organisation
  • Competitive salary package aligned with experience
  • A chance to contribute to a business undergoing positive growth and transformation

job.title: Compliance Officer
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established organisation for an experienced Compliance Officer. In this role, you will take ownership of regulatory compliance, anti-money laundering (AML) controls, and risk management processes, ensuring the organisation meets all applicable legal and regulatory requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for a driven professional to play a pivotal role in maintaining the integrity and compliance of a respected financial institution.

Company Information

You will be joining a reputable organisation within the banking and financial services sector. The business is known for its strong governance framework, commitment to regulatory compliance, and high ethical standards. The culture is professional, collaborative, and supportive, providing an environment where compliance is valued as a key strategic function. You will work closely with a knowledgeable compliance team and senior leadership, contributing to the organisation’s ongoing success.

Responsibilities and Duties

As a Compliance Officer, you will:

  • Prepare and submit quarterly and annual compliance reports, including reporting to senior management and the Board
  • Oversee AML/CFT frameworks and support compliance committees
  • Develop, implement, and monitor policies, procedures, and regulatory controls
  • Manage KYC processes, including onboarding, due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and offboarding
  • Conduct risk assessments for clients, products, and services using a risk-based approach
  • Investigate suspicious activities and escalate reports to relevant authorities as required
  • Deliver compliance training to staff and maintain accurate records
  • Respond to regulatory and law enforcement enquiries in a timely and professional manner

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field
  • A recognised AML or compliance certification (e.g. FIBA or equivalent)
  • A minimum of 4 years’ experience in AML, compliance, or financial crime prevention
  • Strong knowledge of AML regulations, sanctions regimes, and compliance frameworks
  • Experience with transaction monitoring systems and KYC processes
  • Fluency in Spanish (written and verbal)
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to meet tight deadlines
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and communication skills

Benefits and Perks

The organisation offers a competitive package designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing, including:

  • Comprehensive benefits in line with Cayman Islands labour law
  • Full-time, Monday to Friday working schedule (40 hours per week)
  • Opportunity to work within a respected and growing financial institution
  • Exposure to senior leadership and strategic initiatives
  • Professional development within a supportive compliance environment

job.title: Manager of People & Culture
job.description:
Job Summary

We are recruiting on behalf of our client for an experienced Manager of People & Culture to lead the delivery of strategic HR initiatives and foster a high-performing, inclusive workplace. In this role, you will partner closely with senior leadership and employees to design and implement people strategies that drive engagement, talent development and organisational success. You will play a key role in shaping the employee experience while ensuring compliance with HR best practice and local employment regulations. 
 

Company Information

Our client is a well-established organisation operating within a dynamic commercial sector, recognised for its strong focus on customer service, innovation and community involvement. The company is committed to building a positive workplace culture where employees are supported, valued and empowered to perform at their best. 

You will be joining a collaborative leadership environment and overseeing a dedicated People & Culture function. The organisation promotes continuous improvement, professional growth and a people-first approach to business success, making it an ideal environment for an experienced HR professional to thrive.


Responsibilities and Duties

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive HR strategy aligned with business objectives and organisational goals
  • Oversee day-to-day HR operations, including employee relations, performance management and compensation and benefits
  • Manage the full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle to attract and retain top talent
  • Lead workforce planning, succession planning and employee development initiatives
  • Provide expert HR advice and guidance to managers and employees at all levels
  • Manage core HR processes including disciplinary procedures, promotions and terminations
  • Oversee HR administration, including payroll, pensions, health insurance and immigration matters
  • Champion a culture of engagement, innovation and continuous improvement across the organisation 


Qualifications and Skills

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resource Management or a related discipline
  • At least 5 years’ experience in an HR management position
  • Strong knowledge of employment legislation, including labour, immigration and benefits regulations
  • Proven experience developing and implementing HR policies and employee engagement initiatives
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders
  • Strong communication and documentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to align HR strategy with business objectives
  • A collaborative approach with strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities


Benefits and Perks

job.title: Compliance Analyst
job.description:

  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills

  • A proactive and analytical approach to problem-solving

Benefits and Perks

job.title: Senior Compliance Executive
job.description:
We are recruiting for a Senior Regulatory Compliance Executive on behalf of a well-established, global financial technology organisation. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end compliance monitoring for licensed entities, ensuring regulatory frameworks remain robust, current, and defensible. This is a senior, hands-on position where your judgement, regulatory insight, and analytical rigour will directly protect and strengthen regulated operations.
Company Information
You will be joining a fast-growing fintech operating across multiple regulated jurisdictions, including investment business and virtual asset services. The organisation combines innovative technology with strong governance and is recognised for taking a forward-thinking approach to compliance and regulatory engagement.
  • Operates within the fintech, investment services, and digital assets space
  • Strong emphasis on regulatory integrity and licence preservation
  • Collaborative, high-performance compliance culture
  • Global operations with a dedicated Cayman Islands compliance team
  • Regular interaction with senior stakeholders, boards, and regulators
  • Environment that values ownership, accountability, and innovation

Responsibilities and Duties
As a Senior Regulatory Compliance Executive, you will be responsible for:
  • Owning and executing the Compliance Monitoring Programme (CMP) for assigned licensed entities
  • Assessing regulatory change, conducting gap analyses, and advising on business impact
  • Preparing board-level compliance reports, risk assessments, and regulatory updates
  • Managing regulatory submissions, statutory filings, and ongoing reporting obligations
  • Acting as a key contact during regulatory inspections, audits, and examinations
  • Drafting, maintaining, and enhancing compliance policies and frameworks
  • Providing practical regulatory guidance to internal stakeholders
  • Identifying opportunities to improve compliance processes through automation and smarter controls

Qualifications and Skills
To succeed in this role, you will bring:
  • At least 7 years’ experience in regulatory compliance or compliance monitoring

  • Strong knowledge of investment business regulation; exposure to derivatives, CFDs, or virtual assets is advantageous
  • Familiarity with offshore regulatory authorities (or the ability to learn frameworks quickly)
  • Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing regulator- and board-ready documentation
  • Analytical mindset with the confidence to make informed compliance judgements
  • Degree in law, finance, compliance, or a related discipline

Benefits and Perks
You can expect a competitive and well-rounded package, including:
  • Attractive, tax-efficient remuneration reflective of seniority and experience

  • Exposure to fintech, investment business, and digital asset regulation
  • Collaborative and professional working environment
  • Career development within a globally active compliance function
  • Based in the Cayman Islands with access to an excellent lifestyle and benefits
